title: How Many Are in This Image? A Safety Evaluation Benchmark for Vision LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark measures safety aspects of Vision LLMs, specifically out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization and adversarial robustness (misleading attacks and jailbreaking).
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
